description.en: The 9-contact D-subminiature connector with socket contacts (MIL-DTL-24308 shell size 1, a 'receptacle' in the standard's words, sold as DE-9 female): two rows of 5 and 4 sockets in a keystone-shaped shell, on the same flange as the pin connector. A joystick cable ends in one.
description.es: El conector D-subminiatura de 9 contactos con contactos hembra (MIL-DTL-24308 tamaño de carcasa 1, «receptacle» en palabras de la norma, vendido como DE-9 hembra): dos filas de 5 y 4 contactos hembra en una carcasa trapezoidal, sobre la misma brida que el conector de pines. El cable de un joystick termina en uno.
description.fr: Le connecteur D-subminiature à 9 contacts à douilles (MIL-DTL-24308 taille de boîtier 1, « receptacle » selon la norme, vendu comme DE-9 femelle) : deux rangées de 5 et 4 douilles dans un boîtier trapézoïdal, sur la même collerette que le connecteur à broches. Le câble d'un joystick se termine par l'un d'eux.
description.pt: O conector D-subminiatura de 9 contatos com contatos fêmea (MIL-DTL-24308 tamanho de carcaça 1, «receptacle» nas palavras da norma, vendido como DE-9 fêmea): duas filas de 5 e 4 soquetes numa carcaça trapezoidal, sobre o mesmo flange do conector de pinos. O cabo de um joystick termina num deles.

frame_convention: Origin at the centre of the flange's front face (the face toward the mating connector), midway between the mounting holes. +z points toward the mating connector, along the contacts; +y points toward the keystone's wide side; +x = y × z, so seen from +z the socket insert is the mirror of the pin insert front, contact 1 at the upper right. The rear body lies at z < 0.

shell_protrusion_min.note: G, the D-shell ahead of the flange

row_spacing.note: true position; the rows are offset .054

panel_cutout_back_mount_width.note: at the wide edge, for a connector behind the panel; 20.47 mm

panel_cutout_front_mount_width.note: at the wide edge, for a connector on the panel's face; 20.70 mm

interfaces.note: Female: its sockets take the pin connector's pins. Framed .265 in (6.731 mm) ahead of the flange's front face, so a mate puts the two flanges the standard's mated spacing apart (Figure 2, ±.015 in). Symmetry 1: the keystone shell admits one orientation. The x_axis is −x so that a mate (a half-turn about the frame's x, ASM-1 §3.4) puts the socket connector's +y side on the pin connector's +y side.

Male: mounted behind a panel, the D-shell goes through the panel's keystone cutout and the flange's front face bears on the panel's back face; screws pass the two holes. The cutout's size depends on front or back mounting (NorComp); the size key is the back-mounted fit.

review_status.note: Drafted in one pass by an agent (console-hyperobjects standard-parts lane, 2026-11-01); facts read from the cited sources on the access date; no language facet has had a native review.

notes: MIL-DTL-24308 is public on ASSIST; inches govern, and the millimetre figures in notes are the ones each drawing prints. The standard names shell size 1, not the trade letter E. Which of the two D-shells nests inside the other is not stated in a sentence; the tables (the socket connector's B and D maxima below the pin connector's minima) are consistent with the socket shell entering the pin shell. Whether the pin connector's B and D are inside or outside dimensions is not resolvable from the figure, so no envelope is given. Panel cutouts cite NorComp's drawing; the standard gives none.
